eslint/rules.test.ts.name: Content lint rule tests
eslint/rules.test.ts.description: Runs the docs/* ESLint rules through Linter on the fixtures the retired content-lint, vars, references and frontmatter gates used.

scripts/ai-bridge.test.ts.name: AI chat bridge tests
scripts/ai-bridge.test.ts.description: Checks the Ask-AI event bridge delivers each prompt to one listener and survives a StrictMode double subscribe and unsubscribe.

scripts/ai-chat-request.test.ts.name: AI chat request guard tests
scripts/ai-chat-request.test.ts.description: Checks the /api/chat request guard returns 400, 403, 413, 415 or 503 for bad origins, sizes, part types, counts and config.

scripts/brand-helper-security.test.ts.name: Brand diagram helper tests
scripts/brand-helper-security.test.ts.description: Spawns the brand-SVG skill's Python security test under .agents and .claude so injected markup and redirected writes stay rejected.

scripts/check-links.test.ts.name: Link checker tests
scripts/check-links.test.ts.description: Checks link extraction, public asset resolution, placeholder expansion and broken-link and missing-include reporting in temp trees.

scripts/check-nitro-release.test.ts.name: Nitro release checker tests
scripts/check-nitro-release.test.ts.description: Runs check-nitro-release against mocked GitHub and Docker Hub: default mode only reports, --to bumps pins, any miss fails before writing.

scripts/clean.test.ts.name: Clean script tests
scripts/clean.test.ts.description: Runs clean.ts in a temp dir and checks it deletes .next and .source, keeps every other file, and exits clean with nothing to remove.

scripts/generate-cli-reference.test.ts.name: Nitro CLI flags generator tests
scripts/generate-cli-reference.test.ts.description: Checks the reader that parses Nitro's CLI flag output and the renderer that writes the cli-flags-reference page.

scripts/generate-contract-addresses.test.name: Contract address generator tests
scripts/generate-contract-addresses.test.description: Checks the contract-address partial renderer plus the stale-file comparison and printed line diff behind --check.

scripts/generate-gas-target.test.ts.name: Gas target generator tests
scripts/generate-gas-target.test.ts.description: Checks the gas-target partial renderer and the validator that rejects a malformed gas-target snapshot.

scripts/generate-stylus-examples.test.ts.name: Stylus example transform tests
scripts/generate-stylus-examples.test.ts.description: Checks, fixture by fixture, the transform that turns Stylus-by-Example sources into committed docs pages.

scripts/generate-stylus-source.test.ts.name: Stylus source checkout tests
scripts/generate-stylus-source.test.ts.description: Exercises the Stylus source runner's checkout boundary through a local Git archive, with no network access.

scripts/image-debt-scan.test.ts.name: Image debt scanner tests
scripts/image-debt-scan.test.ts.description: Checks the image-debt scan.sh keeps newline filenames and threshold values out of bash arithmetic and rejects non-numeric stat output.

scripts/lib/announcement-link.test.ts.name: Announcement link tests
scripts/lib/announcement-link.test.ts.description: Checks the banner link validator accepts https and resolvable docs paths and rejects http, relative, anchor-only and {var:} hrefs.

scripts/lib/client-imports.test.ts.name: Client import boundary tests
scripts/lib/client-imports.test.ts.description: Walks every 'use client' module's imports and fails if one reaches lib/source.ts or a collections module, directly or transitively.

scripts/lib/compact-redirects.test.ts.name: Compact redirects tests
scripts/lib/compact-redirects.test.ts.description: Checks compactRedirects groups exact aliases by destination and permanence, keeps every alias resolving in Next's matcher, and fits its regex limit.

scripts/lib/contribute-repo-links.test.t.name: Contribute repo link tests
scripts/lib/contribute-repo-links.test.t.description: Tripwire that gitConfig matches content/vars.json and no content file or PR template spells this repo's GitHub URL out in full.

scripts/lib/current-redirects.test.mjs.name: Docusaurus redirect builder tests
scripts/lib/current-redirects.test.mjs.description: Checks the Docusaurus route derivation, destination resolution by slug and title, and collision and loop detection in the redirect builder.

scripts/lib/doc-anchors.test.ts.name: Doc anchor tests
scripts/lib/doc-anchors.test.ts.description: Checks heading ids from real MDX transforms with includes, duplicates and explicit ids, and that check-links fails on missing fragments.

scripts/lib/faq-jsonld.test.ts.name: FAQ JSON-LD tests
scripts/lib/faq-jsonld.test.ts.description: Checks the FAQPage structured data emitted on the six FAQ pages.

scripts/lib/faq-links.test.ts.name: FAQ answer link tests
scripts/lib/faq-links.test.ts.description: Checks every site-relative link in a rendered FAQ answer points at a real page.

scripts/lib/faq-pages.test.ts.name: FAQ page mapping tests
scripts/lib/faq-pages.test.ts.description: Checks the FAQ page mapping, the single place Notion slugs meet page paths.

scripts/lib/faq-partial.test.ts.name: FAQ partial generator tests
scripts/lib/faq-partial.test.ts.description: Checks buildPartial's marker and headings and generateFaq's write and check modes against a temp root, never the committed partials.

scripts/lib/faq-security.test.ts.name: FAQ content safety tests
scripts/lib/faq-security.test.ts.description: Renders Notion FAQ fixtures through MDX to prove imported text stays inert and the generator rejects ESM, unsafe schemes and table escapes.

scripts/lib/faq-snapshot.test.ts.name: FAQ snapshot tests
scripts/lib/faq-snapshot.test.ts.description: Checks how Notion rows are grouped and ordered into per-page FAQ snapshots.

scripts/lib/fonts.test.ts.name: Self-hosted font tests
scripts/lib/fonts.test.ts.description: Tripwire that no module Next compiles imports next/font/google, and that the walk reaches the layout that once did.

scripts/lib/generated-partial.test.ts.name: Generated partial helper tests
scripts/lib/generated-partial.test.ts.description: Checks the shared generator helpers: the do-not-edit marker, assertInertMdx, writeOrCheck, symlink-refusing readRegularFile and setOutput.

scripts/lib/http-headers.test.ts.name: HTTP header tests
scripts/lib/http-headers.test.ts.description: Checks siteHeaders sends master's root Link header, baseline security headers, CORS on the markdown routes and a report-only CSP.

scripts/lib/legacy-redirect-literals.tes.name: Legacy redirect literal tests
scripts/lib/legacy-redirect-literals.tes.description: Checks the legacy redirect generator drops /sdk destinations and serializes quotes, expressions and newlines as inert literals.

scripts/lib/link-preview-structure.test..name: Link preview structure tests
scripts/lib/link-preview-structure.test..description: Compiles MDX fixtures through preview-text and Fumadocs' remarkStructure in build order and checks the structured data a preview gets.

scripts/lib/link-preview.test.ts.name: Link preview JSON tests
scripts/lib/link-preview.test.ts.description: Checks buildLinkPreview turns a page's structured data into the JSON the hover card renders.

scripts/lib/llms-index.test.ts.name: LLMs index tests
scripts/lib/llms-index.test.ts.description: Checks formatLlmsIndex opens with master's title and summary and links each page's .md mirror exactly once.

scripts/lib/llms-markdown.test.ts.name: LLMs markdown tests
scripts/lib/llms-markdown.test.ts.description: Compiles MDX fixtures through remarkLlmsMarkdown then Fumadocs' remarkLLMs, in postprocess order, and checks the stored markdown.

scripts/lib/llms-tracking.test.ts.name: LLMs tracking tests
scripts/lib/llms-tracking.test.ts.description: Imports lib/llms-tracking.ts directly under node --test and checks how markdown fetches are recorded.

scripts/lib/markdown-redirects.test.ts.name: Markdown redirect twin tests
scripts/lib/markdown-redirects.test.ts.description: Checks markdownTwins derives a .md redirect for every entry landing on a doc page and none for external, asset, pattern or .md sources.

scripts/lib/master-routes.test.ts.name: Master route tests
scripts/lib/master-routes.test.ts.description: Checks every page route live on master before the Fumadocs cutover is still a page or matches a redirect in redirects.config.ts.

scripts/lib/mdx-comments.test.ts.name: MDX comment tests
scripts/lib/mdx-comments.test.ts.description: Runs the real @mdx-js/mdx processor with remarkLLMs in fumadocs-mdx order to check MDX comments stay out of the processed markdown.

scripts/lib/module-imports.test.ts.name: Module import scanner tests
scripts/lib/module-imports.test.ts.description: Checks importSpecifiers finds ESM and CommonJS dependencies, skips comments and type-only imports, and isClientModule reads the directive.

scripts/lib/nitro-node-image.test.ts.name: Nitro node image sync tests
scripts/lib/nitro-node-image.test.ts.description: Checks rewriteImage, the sync-with-var marker and syncImageInContent update only opted-in pages and never the _versions archive.

scripts/lib/nitro-upstream-paths.test.ts.name: Nitro upstream path tests
scripts/lib/nitro-upstream-paths.test.ts.description: Checks nitroPathPins and nitroSourcePaths collect pinned Nitro paths and findMissingUpstreamPaths looks each up once, sequentially.
